source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Front Suspension, p.3-18

procedures.title: Upper control arm: remove and install
steps: Removal: support the car at the outer end of the lower control arm.
Remove the cotter pin and nut from the upper ball stud and free the stud from the knuckle.
Remove the two nuts holding the upper arm shaft to the front crossmember; Corvette: count the shims at each bolt.
If needed for clearance, remove the bolts attaching the arm to the frame.
Installation: put the arm in place.
Fit the locknuts and bolts holding the arm shaft to the frame; Corvette: put back the same number of shims at each bolt as were removed.
Torque the nuts to the Specifications.
Pass the ball stud through the knuckle, fit and tighten the nut, and install the cotter pin.
Refit the wheel and tire and lower the car.
Bounce the front end to center the bushings, then torque the bushing collar bolts to the Specifications.
notes: See figure 30 in the manual for the upper control arm attachments.
Keeping the shim count preserves the caster and camber setting.
